auditFindings.finding: A public source inventory, historical public CI and isolated newer source are three distinct evidence scopes.
auditFindings.implication: Do not report staging durable/schema7, runner rotation or dirty guest files as executed at public9e. Documentation can archive newer evidence without shipping its source.

auditFindings.finding: npm verify is a core script chain, not complete product verification.
auditFindings.implication: It covers typecheck/lint/Vitest/smoke/Gimbal only; dedicated SQL, OPA build, network OpenTofu, real Temporal, installed browsers, images/clusters/external/live gates require their own execution.

auditFindings.finding: Baseline backend opt-ins can disappear from execution without a skipped count.
auditFindings.implication: When PG_URL or Supabase keys are absent, some describe.each backend matrices contain only PGlite/FileStore. A zero-skipped default report cannot prove PostgreSQL or PostgREST coverage; strict required backend ancestry/manifest matters.

auditFindings.finding: Several live/OS/cluster opt-ins are not enabled by every public mandatory lane.
auditFindings.implication: Track private source, PostgREST/storage, vault PG rewrap, systemd, kind, external mTLS and dedicated deletion guard opt-ins separately; do not silently waive or claim their acceptance.

auditFindings.finding: Contract and local-engine evidence has bounded claims even when passing.
auditFindings.implication: Real provider schema is not cloud apply; fake API/ports are not provider reachability; real local Temporal with fake activities is not HA/mTLS; browser fixture IDP is not real external identity; bare PG is not production DB TLS/pooler/auth/restore.

auditFindings.finding: Lane/file/group/script-check totals overlap and have different counting units.
auditFindings.implication: Keep Vitest file/assertion results, Go package/root/subtest counts, Rego rule counts, browser scripted checks and build command exits separate. No whole-project grand total may sum them.

auditFindings.finding: Production mission coverage is materially broader than implemented test files.
auditFindings.implication: 78 requirements include default clean installation/live application traffic/mixed-cloud partitioning/managed isolation/operational recovery/supply chain/standing grants/commercial signoff. All release flags remain false; listed source tests or testPaths absence are not completion determinations.

auditFindings.finding: Native shell probe invokes sh sh -s instead of sh -s, misdetecting an available shell.
auditFindings.implication: Thirteen guarded document script cases are skipped and hostile argv round-trip case can silently pass without assertions. Test harness correction is pending; no production mutation vulnerability demonstrated.
